description: This Java source file defines a class 'StaticTriangleRenderer' which implements the 'GLSurfaceView.Renderer' interface for rendering a textured triangle using OpenGL ES in an Android environment. It contains inner classes and methods to initialize OpenGL settings, load textures, handle drawing frames, and manage surface changes, including creating buffers for vertex, texture coordinate, and index data.

classes.description: A renderer for drawing a textured triangle using OpenGL ES in Android. Manages initialization, drawing, and resource handling.
